lines.trans: You got me, I got you. Now it's one-all.

words.gram: 1st person plural, genitive; у нас = between us, we have

lines.trans: All by the rules, like a knights' tournament.
Samson, come on, smile. We're at peace.
Samson, don't break anything else of his.
Give me your hand. That's it.
Your wife is a very wise woman. You listen to her.
That's it, Ninok. Now we have our own personal servant.
